professionalSummary.text: Seasoned Release Manager with over three years of experience leading online banking channel releases, managing release calendars, post‑release monitoring, and change advisory board approvals.
professionalSummary.witness: Took twenty‑two releases of the online banking channel through the go‑live weekend into the live channel between 2022 and 2025, holding the release calendar and the go‑live checklist for the channel throughout.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed 22 go‑live weekends, ensuring smooth transition to live channel and maintaining release calendar and checklist.
experienceHighlights.witness: Took twenty‑two releases of the online banking channel through the go‑live weekend into the live channel between 2022 and 2025, holding the release calendar and the go‑live checklist for the channel throughout.

experienceHighlights.text: Conducted post‑release watch with operations, executing two rollbacks when customer error rates exceeded thresholds.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the post‑release watch with operations on each go‑live weekend and called two rollbacks, both when the customer error rate on the login journey rose above the agreed threshold; both are recorded in the change records with their timings.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared releases through the change advisory board, documenting readiness reviews and approvals.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared every release through the change advisory board with a readiness review, keeping the readiness review minutes and the board's approval reference for each release in the release folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Recorded residual risks and hand‑over conditions in release closure notes, ensuring clear post‑go‑live hand‑off.
experienceHighlights.witness: Recorded the residual risks and the hand‑over conditions for each release in the release closure note, including the customer‑facing limitations that stayed open after go‑live.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Release calendar 2024, go‑live checklist, rollback change records, and release closure notes for the last four releases, with change advisory board references.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the release calendar for 2024, the go‑live checklist, the change records for the two rollbacks and the release closure notes for the last four releases, with the change advisory board references as a verification trail.
